visual_action: The video is a slideshow of two images. The first image shows a photo of actress Sarah Jessica Parker with a headline above it that reads: "'For the Love of My Country': Sarah Jessica Parker Endorses Kamala Harris and Tim Walz". The second image shows a woman with long hair, seen from behind, holding a blue "HARRIS WALZ" campaign sign up to a window. A fluffy cat sits on the windowsill next to her.
